params.message:
Sign reviews with key-1 wherever it lives, as did:web:abovebeyond.ai:id

sign-review.mjs opens key-1 through abovebeyond's scripts/key-1.mjs (the YubiKey named
by the descriptor, or a JWK file) and assembles the same credential issueReviewCredential
made, byte for byte. New sign-offs name the successor's did:web, whose key-1 can change;
build.mjs names the latest signer.
